items.fact: The first evaluator draft summarized a mean of per-block DTI ratios, whereas the protocol requires pooled DTI. Before release, evaluator v2 was changed to aggregate TP/FP/FN before scoring and to bootstrap pooled block components.
items.disposition: The pre-v2 draft values are not retained as evidence. v2 was later superseded by IR87-008.

items.fact: Evaluator v2 excluded only the in-core portion of a withheld component from background training. A component extending beyond its core and 30-pixel collar could therefore be mislabeled as background. Evaluator v3 excludes the full support of every withheld component; H87-FRB was rerun and the run card/site were regenerated. The final full-data model and GeoTIFF bytes are unchanged because that model does not use fold training masks.
items.disposition: Use only gems87.spatial_component_holdout.v3 results. V2 numbers are superseded and must not be cited as release evidence.

items.fact: The initial surface duplicate gate used a deterministic 250,000-pixel Spearman sample. Although no sampled comparison was near 0.90, that did not literally prove the required all-footprint rank threshold. Registry v2 now computes exact tie-aware Spearman across every footprint pixel for every materialized raster, with a one-time candidate rank vector and full ranks for nonbinary references.
items.disposition: Use the registry v2 exact-surface receipt only. The release card, sidecar, and site were regenerated after this stronger gate passed.
